entries.title: DDaT25610 - Managed Support
entries.description:
***PLEASE NOTE THIS IS AN AWARD NOTICE, NOT A CALL FOR COMPETITION***

The Department of Energy Security and Net Zero (DESNZ) had a requirement for the provision of Managed Support.  This Call Off contract has been sourced via a longlist shortlist exercise on the G Cloud 14 Framework (RM1557.14).

The Contract includes optional 12 month extension.

Contract Variation 002 was implemented to increase the  original contract value for the initial term by £35,500.00 ex VAT.
entries.extension_note: Release quotes: "The Contract includes optional 12 month extension." Whether it will be exercised is unknown. Award value 163500 GBP differs from tender value 128000 GBP; release quotes a variation increasing initial-term value by GBP 35,500.00 ex VAT
